items.speaker: Scott Bessent
items.quote: Many people believe that they may be making a policy mistake if they overtighten
items.summary: Bessent warned the Fed risks overtightening, citing a run of hawkish comments from governors and a substantial tightening in financial conditions over recent months. He pointed to fragility in the financial system ahead of the December 8-9 FOMC, where a hike is priced. Quotes are from the Bloomberg wire as carried by The Star (article dated Nov 24); the full CBS transcript could not be opened.
items.score_note: Argues against further tightening but does not explicitly demand cuts, so -1 not -2.

coverage_notes: Window 2026-11-20..27. Only Bessent Face the Nation (Nov 22) found with an openable direct quote.
